races.paceDynamic: Cinnabar Moth is the only confirmed front-runner but carries a 'fades in finish' warning after 323 days off, making her pace vulnerable late. The prominent brigade of Ballyhahill, Nirisque, Chautuaqua, Cool Summer and Delorean Dynamite will likely apply pressure early given the lack of alternative pace. This sets up a contested early tempo that could collapse in the final half-mile on testing ground. The tactical advantage clearly lies with hold-up horses who can conserve energy and finish through tired legs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cinnabar Moth's long absence shows early and the prominent pack goes too hard
scenarios.body: The pace collapses from 2f out as the soft ground takes its toll on early leaders. Crohan Lady and Evelyn emerge from the pack with strong finishing kicks to dominate the business end.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Group Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays manageable and Ballyhahill or Nirisque travel strongly
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets first run on the field and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can respond. The soft ground expertise and race fitness prove decisive over raw finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Cinnabar Moth settles better than expected and avoids early pressure
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets an easy lead and conserves enough energy to repel late challenges on ground that plays to her stamina. Her 323-day break becomes irrelevant if unopposed early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Shock Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced horses cancel each other out through a fierce pace battle
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomers benefit from a truly-run race that exposes stamina limitations in the proven performers. Fresh legs and untapped potential prove superior to exposed form.

watchPoints.text: Cinnabar Moth's jumping and stamina after 323 days off - if she makes early mistakes or gets headed before 2f out she could collapse quickly
The pace scenario in the first half-mile - if Ballyhahill, Nirisque and Chautuaqua all go forward together they could set up a sitting duck scenario
Crohan Lady's position turning for home - she has the highest topspeed rating and could be the biggest danger if getting a clear run
Weather conditions before racing - any further rain could turn soft ground heavy and favour the most experienced campaigners
The three lightly-raced maidens early in the race - if any show speed or travel well they could outrun their odds in a weak contest

races.paceDynamic: Kentucky Beach will control the early tempo with minimal pressure, as the field contains mostly hold-up and midfield types with only Ballet Queen, Salvador Peps and Polepatrick likely to track the leader. This sets up a moderate, sustainable gallop that should hold together well on the soft ground. Without genuine pace pressure, the race will develop into a tactical affair where those able to travel and pick up from off the pace will have the advantage. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those who can finish strongly, as the modest early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kentucky Beach sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to conserve energy and unleash their finishing kicks. Those with proven stamina reserves will sweep past the tiring leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens approaching the final hurdle as prominent runners challenge Kentucky Beach
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field but doesn't collapse entirely, suiting those who travelled well in behind the leader. Strong travelling horses in prominent positions can kick clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Kentucky Beach maintains his advantage and no serious challenger emerges from the pack
scenarios.body: The leader's uncontested advantage proves decisive as the chasing pack fails to organize an effective challenge. Soft ground aids his stamina and he stays on grimly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes pedestrian and turns into a sprint finish from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of speed rather than stamina, favouring those with natural acceleration regardless of position. The strongest finishers benefit from the slow early sections.

watchPoints.text: Kentucky Beach could get an uncontested lead which would make him very difficult to peg back
Euro Agent, Lanzhou, Brave Josee, Colesberg and Stone Rulya all show tendencies to fade in the finish

Several horses carry claiming jockeys which could impact their chances in a competitive field

races.paceDynamic: Drombane will take the field along from the front at a sustainable gallop, with no confirmed pace rival to pressure him through the early stages. Jackmoon and Charlie's Dilemma may track prominently but both have shown they can settle, leaving Drombane largely uncontested for the first circuit. The field will bunch up turning for home with plenty of stamina reserves intact, creating a finish where horses with tactical speed and strong finishing kicks can strike. This moderate pace setup heavily favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing ability.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the field remains bunched turning in
scenarios.body: Drombane's uncontested lead creates the perfect setup for closers to unleash finishing kicks in the straight. Horses like Mr Master Mac, Dont Tell Jack and Lunar Majesty who have shown ability to quicken off steady gallops will have ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Drombane gets an easy lead and finds extra gears when challenged
scenarios.body: The Willie Mullins-trained veteran exploits the lack of early pace pressure to dictate terms throughout. His proven stamina at the trip and tactical positioning advantage could prove decisive if he has enough left for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Jackmoon or Charlie's Dilemma track the leader perfectly and time their move
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigners use their race positioning to get first run on the field turning in. Their superior fitness levels and course craft allows them to bridge the gap to Drombane while holding off the late closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Breakthrough Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Teddy's Acre or Codger's Rock shows significantly improved form
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced horses produce unexposed improvement to capitalise on the tactical race setup. Their fresher profiles and potential untapped ability catches the more exposed rivals off guard in a slowly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Watch Drombane's jumping early - if he's fluent over the first few flights he could steal a decisive advantage
Monitor how Jackmoon and Charlie's Dilemma position themselves - if both track the leader it changes the pace dynamic significantly
Teddy's Acre is a complete unknown quantity - any market support would be highly significant given his lightly-raced profile
Observe the layoff returnees Mr Master Mac and Lupin Du Groschene for signs of ring-rustiness in the preliminaries
Check if any of the hold-up horses get too far back early - in a steadily-run race they could leave themselves too much to do

races.paceDynamic: King Of Westeros is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate a measured early pace without pressure, allowing the race to develop steadily through the soft ground over this extended trip. The prominent runners Maciver, Roccabaker, and Elusive Prince will track the leader but are unlikely to force the issue early given the distance and conditions. This creates a race where the large contingent of hold-up horses including Poppycon, Coffeys Forge, Imarajan, and Ellies Rock can get into the race from off the pace. The sustainable early gallop and stamina-sapping soft ground strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late rallies when the early pace-makers weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Westeros sets his typical steady pace without pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The soft ground and extended trip will find out the early leaders in the final half-mile, allowing closers to pick up the pieces. Horses like Poppycon, Coffeys Forge, Imarajan and Ellies Rock are perfectly positioned to capitalize on the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Press Forward
scenarios.trigger: If Maciver or Roccabaker decides to challenge King Of Westeros earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This forces a stronger pace that could set up the race for mid-division runners who avoid the early battle. The increased tempo may still favor late runners but brings prominent racers more into play.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: King Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Westeros maintains his stamina better than expected and the pace remains truly steady throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to save energy for a sustained finish, potentially holding off late challengers. Other prominent runners who conserved energy early could also benefit from the weak pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: This negates the stamina advantages and could favor horses with tactical speed regardless of their usual running style. The race becomes more about who quickens best rather than who stays longest.

watchPoints.text: King Of Westeros must be watched early - if he goes off too fast or gets challenged aggressively, the race dynamic changes completely
Monitor how aggressively Maciver and Roccabaker position themselves - if either presses forward early it could set up a different race
Watch for Poppycon and Imarajan to be held up in rear early, as they need the pace to develop to be maximally effective
Several horses carry warnings about fading in the finish - Mollys Dolly, Appian Way, Topothelane and The Cobblers Wife could stop quickly
The 18-runner field means positioning will be crucial - watch for hold-up horses to get clear runs in the home straight

races.paceDynamic: Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic will contest the early lead with both committed front-runners likely to go a strong gallop from the outset. Seven prominent racers including Casey West, Lisleigh Lad, General Clermont, Sammy Smart, and Aclass create serious traffic congestion behind the leaders, setting up potential trouble at the business end. The soft ground and extended trip will test stamina reserves as the pace-setters dig in. This honest gallop and crowded prominent positions strongly favour the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrum and finish with one run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic maintain strong early pace creating genuine test
scenarios.body: The leaders will stretch the field allowing patient riders on Tullyveery Lad, Binge Worthy, Killinure Lass and Nettuno Italia to pick off tired leaders in final furlong. Traffic problems for prominent group leave clear path for hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is only moderate allowing prominent group to stay in touch
scenarios.body: Casey West, Aclass, Sammy Smart and General Clermont will have enough left to surge past weakening leaders in closing stages. Their tactical positioning proves ideal as they avoid early speed battle but don't get too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one leader gets soft lead while other fades early
scenarios.body: Mount Frisco has better recent form than Doyen Magic and could pinch crucial lengths if getting uncontested lead. Soft ground will test stamina but his proven ability at this trip gives him fighting chance to hold on.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Lottery
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and tie up badly
scenarios.body: Complete pace collapse leaves race wide open for any horse with stamina reserves regardless of position. Form and class become secondary to which horse finds best racing room in final quarter-mile scramble.

watchPoints.text: Mount Frisco and Doyen Magic will clash early and if they go too fast both could tie up leaving race wide open
Casey West and Aclass both want prominent positions creating potential traffic problems turning for home with seven horses fighting for same spot
Tullyveery Lad and Binge Worthy are the class hold-up horses who could benefit most if early pace is strong
Carrig Sam returns after 419 days absence and fitness will be major question despite excellent soft ground record
Nettuno Italia carries just 146lbs which is significant weight advantage in competitive handicap of this nature

races.paceDynamic: Kotkito Bello and Marelly will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a reasonable gallop on this testing Soft ground. The pace shouldn't be excessive given only two natural leaders, but the ground will ensure it becomes a test of stamina as they swing for home. Several hold-up horses including In The Trenches, Splashing Out, and Torquay Road will look to pounce late, but the moderate early pace and stamina-sapping conditions favor horses who can travel prominently and have something left when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Kotkito Bello and Marelly set sensible fractions without burning each other out
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows one or both to kick clear in the straight, with the testing ground preventing late closers from making significant inroads. Prominent racers like Icare d'Aubrelle and Nas Na Riogh are best placed to challenge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late surge prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely testing and compromises the front pair
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup as Kotkito Bello and Marelly weaken, allowing strong finishers to sweep past in the final furlong. In The Trenches and Torquay Road have the class to capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: Icare d'Aubrelle or Nas Na Riogh can time their challenge perfectly, getting first run on the tiring leaders while holding off the hold-up horses. Jack Kennedy's presence on Icare d'Aubrelle adds tactical nous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a true slog where class matters less than stamina and a good ride
scenarios.body: A Snow White Park or Soldante could emerge from the pack if the principals fail to fire, taking advantage of their light weights and any tactical errors ahead. The testing conditions could level the playing field.

watchPoints.text: Kotkito Bello setting too strong an early pace and compromising both front-runners
In The Trenches and Splashing Out getting good positions early despite hold-up styles, as late runs may struggle

Marelly getting into an early speed duel with stable companion Kotkito Bello

races.paceDynamic: Itsalonglongroad will set an uncontested lead with no other confirmed front runners in this field of predominantly hold-up horses. The 12-year-old veteran will dictate terms throughout on soft ground that suits his profile, establishing a methodical rhythm over this 1m7½f trip. Behind him, Courtbrack Boy may track prominently while the other eight runners bunch up in midfield and rear positions. This uncontested pace scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable scramble when the hold-up horses make their moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Itsalonglongroad Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran gets his preferred easy lead without pressure from the flag
scenarios.body: The 12-year-old can parcel out his energy perfectly on the testing ground, making his experience count when the challengers arrive too late. His 138-day break becomes an asset rather than concern as fresher legs carry him home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground saps Itsalonglongroad's stamina reserves in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses find their rhythm perfectly as the leader weakens, with several coming with strong late runs. Form horses with better recent activity levels capitalise on the leader's long absence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Courtbrack Boy Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner successfully tracks the leader before striking decisively approaching the last
scenarios.body: The 6-year-old uses his class advantage and recent form edge to time his challenge perfectly, benefiting from the pace without doing the donkey work. His fitness from a 24-day break proves ideal compared to others' longer layoffs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Itsalonglongroad struggles dramatically with his lengthy absence on the testing ground
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last fence as no horse can sustain a strong gallop in the conditions. The freshest horses with recent runs gain a decisive advantage in a slowly-run affair.

watchPoints.text: Set The Tone jumping unreliably throughout after pulling up last time over fences - avoid backing anything near him
Itsalonglongroad tiring dramatically after two miles given his 138-day layoff on energy-sapping soft ground
Courtbrack Boy tracking closer than usual to the leader early, suggesting connections plan to capitalise on the uncontested pace
La Tene and Spanish Maid travelling strongly turning for home after their recent promising efforts on similar ground
L'Amiral Fromentin fading badly from two out despite being in contention, confirming his established finishing pattern
